biology_deepdive_20260822.status: PROPOSED ANNOTATION — informs the record; verdict/gates/triggers above remain authoritative and unchanged
biology_deepdive_20260822.size_gate_reading_today: M9140 published Ph1 (Nat Med Oct-2025, PMID 40739424): confirmed ORR 7.5% (3/40; 8.8% at active doses >=2.4) vs CX-2051 20%/32% confirmed at 8.6/10 mg/kg — M9140 does NOT match/beat => gate OPEN, starter NOT terminal-capped on published data. Decisive datum (M9140 optimization-dose ORR) has a date window: PROCEADE-CRC-01 primary completion 2026-10-23 (registry-verified).
biology_deepdive_20260822.kill_trigger_annotation: The 'G3 diarrhea >15%' trigger must be read against the GO-FORWARD prophylaxis regimen (10% at n=20, 2mo follow-up; loperamide/diphenoxylate + budesonide), NOT the legacy pooled 23.8% (19/80) which predates mandated prophylaxis — pooled figure would false-fire the trigger. Benchmark = prophylaxis-cohort rate at the end-2026 update (n~40 goal).
biology_deepdive_20260822.differentiated_view: First agent to open a therapeutic window on EpCAM systemically (no DLTs at 10 mg/kg on a target that killed IV catumaxomab at microgram doses); competitor's Ph3 launched off 2-4x WORSE like-for-like published ORR, moved earlier-line, no expression cutoff on a heterogeneous target = urgency not dominance; cross-resistance bear refuted by sponsors' own 96-100% prior-irinotecan enrollment; registration bar is FTD/TPI-class 1-2% ORR / 1.9-3.7mo mPFS (Nat Med-cited), not M9140.

fda_annex_20260822.sources: KRAZATI label (openFDA SPL 2026-03-25) + AA letter NDA216340/S-005 (accessdata); TUKYSA label; FDA draft AA-oncology guidance (Mar-2023, STILL DRAFT); Project Optimus dosage guidance (FINAL Aug-2024)
fda_annex_20260822.registrational_bar: Two on-point refractory-CRC ORR+DOR accelerated approvals: KRAZATI+cetuximab 6/2024 single-arm n=94 cORR 34% (25-45) mDOR 5.8mo w/ randomized earlier-line confirmatory scheduled at approval (completion 03/2027); TUKYSA+trastuzumab 1/2023 single-arm n=84 ORR 38% mDOR 12.4mo. Bar for CX-2051: ~30%+ cORR at optimized dose, n~90-120 single-arm, plus DOR — DOR is the statutory pillar CytomX has NOT yet disclosed.
fda_annex_20260822.design_signal_1H27: Single-arm mono + named confirmatory = KRAZATI-shaped fast path (AA filing ~2028); randomized vs FTD/TPI = guidance-shaped timeline repricing (M9140 runs randomized BECAUSE 7.5% ORR cannot clear a single-arm bar — CX-2051 32% keeps the fast door open).
fda_annex_20260822.optimus_rubric_end2026: PASS: AIBW-10 holds >=~25-30% cORR, prophylaxis G3 diarrhea <=15%, low discontinuations -> top dose survives. SPLIT: tolerability favors 8.6, ORR settles 20-25% (below 34-38% precedent bar) -> DOR-dependent, randomized-design risk up. FAIL: G3 >15% both doses / FDA forces unstudied dose -> existing kill/exit triggers. Whether AIBW cohort is formally randomized: UNVERIFIED.
